userRequest: Exercise a sequence of rapid clicks rather than only a two-click pair.
scope: One authenticated production Dashboard run using five rapid, non-form navigation clicks; no client records or form contents were read.

environment.extensionPresence: not determined; EvaluateScript source URL metadata was unavailable for the recorded scripts

interaction.mechanism: CDP mouseMoved/mousePressed/mouseReleased on visible navigation-rail links
interaction.activeNavigationMarkerAt250msCheck: remained on the preceding link for each transition

preliminaryLocatorSequence.interpretation: The locator API waited multiple seconds per action, so this method was not used as the rapid-input result; direct CDP input was used for the recorded five-click sequence.

browserTrace.format: Chrome trace JSON stream captured from Edge
browserTrace.rawTraceRetention: held in the browser automation session through validation; no raw artifact or checkpoint was created
browserTrace.extensionScriptAttribution: not possible from the available EvaluateScript source metadata

failedRequest.interpretation: request cancellation observed during route changes; not an HTTP error

networkCapture.completeness: no event-buffer truncation, but two requests had no loadingFinished event by capture end

assessment.interpretation: All five click events were dispatched and each target URL path appeared at the 250 ms check. The selected-navigation marker still reflected the prior route at that check, then eventually settled to Dashboard. No 50 ms main-thread RunTask or click EventDispatch occurred in this sequence. Shared shell/API reads and RSC traffic overlapped the clicks; the slowest observed completed app request was about 1.03 s. This does not identify whether those waits came from server, database, network, or client coordination.

formalStatus.hostedPhase1: unchanged: BLOCKED, 0/3 valid paired records, 5/5 attempts consumed

nextAction: Do not repeat the exhausted Phase 1 identity or old test matrices. The rapid Edge sequence did not reproduce a renderer long-task freeze but did show short-lived navigation-marker lag and repeated shell/API reads. Any further causal test needs a new bounded evidence identity and a synchronized host sample; first verify script-source attribution and preserve the supported trace transfer path.
